headline: Groom left without marrying after not getting goat meat at wedding event
summary: A groom reportedly abandoned his wedding ceremony after failing to receive goat meat as part of the meal, leading to the cancellation of the marriage.
details: A wedding ceremony was abruptly called off after the groom reportedly walked out without completing the marriage rituals. The incident occurred when the groom expressed dissatisfaction with the food arrangements at the event.

According to local reports, the groom was specifically upset because he was not served goat meat (khashi mangsho) during the wedding feast. This particular dish is often considered a staple or a special item at such celebrations.
Despite efforts by the bride's family and other attendees to appease him, the groom remained adamant and eventually left the venue. His departure led to the immediate cancellation of the wedding.
The unexpected turn of events left both families and guests in shock and disappointment. The incident has sparked discussions on social media regarding wedding expectations and cultural traditions.

headline: Former freedom fighter commander alleges Awami League forcibly made innocent people Razakars
summary: The former commander claims that innocent individuals were falsely labeled as Razakars by the Awami League. This accusation comes from a respected figure, adding weight to the controversial statement.
details: A former freedom fighter commander has made a serious allegation, claiming that the Awami League forcibly labeled innocent individuals as Razakars. This statement has sparked controversy and raised questions about historical narratives.

The commander asserted that many who were not involved with the Razakar forces during the 1971 Liberation War were unjustly implicated. He suggested these actions were politically motivated to target opponents.

Razakars were a paramilitary force that collaborated with the Pakistan Army during the 1971 Bangladesh Liberation War. Being labeled a Razakar carries significant social and political stigma in Bangladesh.

The commander did not provide specific examples or evidence during his statement, but his position as a former freedom fighter lends credibility to the gravity of his claims. Further investigation or clarification from the Awami League is awaited.
